title: Microsoft opens Ignite with agents, not devices, at the centre of the keynote
summary: Microsoft opens its Ignite conference in San Francisco on Tuesday, with chairman and chief executive Satya Nadella and commercial chief Judson Althoff leading a keynote expected to centre on agents rather than new hardware. The company has been positioning Agent 365, its agent control plane, as an observability layer spanning models, assistants and third-party agents. Sessions run through 20 November; Microsoft has not published its announcements in advance and its Book of News is due after the keynote.
